Ailment: Ailment is a status effect that can be inflicted on enemies, causing them to take damage over time (DOT) or suffer from other negative effects.
Ailment Mastery: Ticking damage from ailments is increased by a percentage. For example, if a character has 100% Ailment Mastery, they will deal double damage from ailments. If they have 150% Ailment Mastery, they will deal 2.5x damage from ailments -- DOTs.
Bankai: A Soul Reaper's final, most powerful Zanpakutō release — the stage beyond Shikai.
Crit DMG: The % of damage dealt when a critical hit is rolled. For example, if a character has 100% Crit DMG, they will deal double damage on a critical hit. If they have 150% Crit DMG, they will deal 2.5x damage on a critical hit.
Crit Rate: The chances that you roll a critical hit on attack.
Getsuga Tensho: Ichigo release a dark sword wave that strikes the target from afar, dealing DMG equal to 580% of ATK and inflicting 1 stack of Getsuga Mark for 5s. Tap the basic attack button when the technique hits the enemy, and Ichigo will dash to them and release a special attack. After Hollowfication, Ichigo releases a Getsuga Tensho twice in a row, dealing DMG equal to 870% of ATK with the first attack and 870% of ATK with the second.
Perfect Dodge: A defensive technique that allows the user to evade an enemy's attack with perfect timing. When executed correctly, the user will avoid taking damage and may gain a temporary advantage in combat.
Reiatsu: The physical force of a being's spiritual pressure / spiritual energy.
Shikai: The initial released form of a Zanpakutō, activated by its release command.
